info.name: Giggy Speech API
info.description:
Giggy makes Voice AI affordable enough to offer hosted text-to-speech largely for free. Try free Batch TTS or paid Fast generation.

[Giggy.ai](https://giggy.ai) provides a text-to-speech REST API. Batch uses zero credits and is queued; Fast consumes credits and receives higher queue priority.

## Quick start

1. Create a Giggy API key in Speech API → API Keys and select a voice UUID in the API Playground.
2. Fork this collection into your workspace. Set `GIGGY_API_KEY` in a private Postman environment; never publish the key.
3. Set `voiceId` to your valid voice UUID and `sampleText` to the text to speak. `baseUrl` defaults to `https://giggy.ai`.
4. Send **Free Batch TTS** or **Fast TTS (Paid)**. Both wait for completed MP3 audio; no job polling is required.
5. Check HTTP 200 and `audio/mpeg`, then use **Send and Download** or **Save Response** to save `speech.mp3`. Allow up to 600 seconds for queued requests.

Batch is subject to queues, request-size limits, and rate limits. Errors return JSON; stop on errors rather than saving them as MP3.

## Developer resources

- [Giggy Speech API documentation](https://giggy.ai/docs/speech-api)
- [Free Batch TTS with Python](https://github.com/giggy-ai/giggy-examples/tree/main/python/basic-tts)
- [Giggy vs ElevenLabs listening comparison](https://github.com/giggy-ai/giggy-examples/tree/main/tutorials/02-giggy-vs-elevenlabs)
